40fc39f00f5301f5.description: About the Role Ninja is looking for skilled Maintenance Technicians to perform preventive and reactive maintenance across our stores and facilities. The ideal candidate will have practical experience in electrical systems, HVAC, and refrigeration, ensuring equipment reliability and smooth store operations. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and repair electrical, HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, and basic building defects. Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, inspections, cleaning, and equipment checks. Respond to urgent breakdowns and maintenance requests as scheduled. Update maintenance work orders with findings, parts used, photos, and completion details. Follow safety procedures and use approved tools and personal protective equipment (PPE). Coordinate maintenance activities with store teams and report recurring issues or warranty-related defects. Escalate complex repairs requiring specialist support or external service providers. Technical diploma or trade certificate. 3–5 years of practical maintenance experience. Working knowledge of electrical systems, HVAC, and refrigeration. Ability to perform preventive and corrective maintenance. Familiarity with mobile work orders or maintenance management systems. Strong troubleshooting skills and commitment to workplace safety

405ecae589ce8b95.job_title: IB Spanish and World Language Teacher
405ecae589ce8b95.description: About the Role ISG Jubail is seeking an IB Spanish and World Language Teacher to join their team in the Eastern region, specifically in Al Jubail or Al Khobar. This full-time role focuses on developing linguistic fluency, cultural understanding, and global awareness in students. The ideal candidate will foster intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, and meaningful communication within the framework of the IB Diploma Programme and modern language standards. Key Responsibilities Demonstrate commitment to child protection and the safety of children and young people. Embed a philosophy of learning language, learning about language, and learning through language to enhance fluency, cultural understanding, and critical thinking. Design inquiry-based experiences that connect language learning to real-world issues and interdisciplinary concepts. Plan and deliver lessons in accordance with established curriculum goals and objectives. Maintain accurate student attendance records, grades, and other required documentation. Evaluate and grade student classwork and assignments, and administer examinations. Provide additional support to students requiring assistance with coursework outside of class. Observe, monitor, and record student progress, responding to individual needs and abilities. Initiate, facilitate, and moderate classroom discussions effectively. Plan, evaluate, and revise curricula, course content, materials, and instructional methods. Stay informed of developments in the field through literature, peer collaboration, and professional conferences. Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research matters. Contribute to academic or administrative committees addressing institutional policies and departmental issues. Supervise student after-school activities or coach/assistant coach athletic teams. Maintain a safe learning environment for students and staff. Perform other duties as assigned by the principal and/or assistant principal. Specific Responsibilities for IB Spanish / World Languages Deliver IB Spanish instruction aligned with the IBDP course guide and best practices. Support students in constructing their understanding of linguistic and cultural concepts. Create an environment that encourages student agency in language learning. Develop and foster interdisciplinary connections within language learning. Act as an advocate for high school students, learning, and programs. Contribute to the creation and revision of the language curriculum. Share interests and passions with students through after-school programs. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will understand the developmental needs of middle and high school students and actively contribute to the wider school community. This role requires a commitment to the school's mission of inspiring innovation and compassionate action, alongside a demonstrated ability to be creative in teaching approaches.

407db1f261a1d552.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سيرة النخبة للتجارة عن بائع مأكولات ومشروبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد وتقديم المشروبات للعملاء، مع ضمان جودة الخدمة والنظافة في منطقة العمل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتحضير القهوة والمشروبات الساخنة والباردة وفق الوصفات ومعايير الجودة المعتمدة. تشغيل آلة الإسبريسو ومطحنة القهوة وأدوات التحضير، وضبط كميات القهوة والحليب والإضافات حسب طلب العميل. استقبال طلبات العملاء والتأكد من تفاصيلها، وتجهيزها وتقديمها بأسلوب لبق وفي الوقت المناسب. المحافظة على جودة المشروبات ومظهرها، والتعامل مع ملاحظات العملاء وإبلاغ المسؤول عند الحاجة. تنظيف معدات وأدوات التحضير وتعقيمها، والمحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل. متابعة توفر القهوة والحليب والأكواب وبقية المستلزمات، وإبلاغ المسؤول عند قرب نفادها. الالتزام بالنظافة الشخصية واشتراطات سلامة الغذاء وحفظ المواد بالطريقة المناسبة. التعاون مع بقية فريق العمل لضمان سرعة الخدمة وجودتها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إعداد المشروبات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المشروبات. بيئة العمل يعمل بائع المأكولات والمشروبات في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والتعاون مع فريق العمل. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

40657dad1fc09bb4.job_title: Vascular and Emergency Medicine Sales Product Specialist Damman EZ (eastern zone)
40657dad1fc09bb4.description: About the Role King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center (KFSH) in Riyadh is seeking an Assistant Consultant, Vascular Surgery. This full-time position involves the diagnosis and treatment of medical diseases and conditions within the field of Vascular Surgery, ensuring the provision of medical care in accordance with established medical staff bylaws, rules, regulations, and hospital policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Assist the Consultant in providing patient care and management in Vascular Surgery, adhering to KFSH & RC medical care standards. Deliver high-quality patient care across all aspects of General Vascular Surgery, consistent with approved clinical privileges. Provide timely consultations for inpatients and emergency room cases, responding within prescribed hospital policy timeframes. Ensure timely completion, accuracy, and eligibility of medical records. Provide on-call service, ensuring availability and response within hospital policy timeframes. Conduct daily morning rounds to identify patients ready for discharge and ensure discharge orders are written 24 hours prior to discharge. Participate in educational activities, training programs, and national and international medical conferences as assigned. Provide orientation, bedside training, and supervision to interns, residents, and fellows. Engage in clinical, basic, and translational research projects in line with Research Advisory Council Policy. Undertake administrative duties assigned by the Head of Section or Chairman, including participation in departmental activities and committees. Adhere to hospital and medical staff bylaws, rules, regulations, and policies, staying updated on any changes. Qualifications and Experience Graduation from a medical school in good standing. Completion of the required period of postgraduate training in a specialty and/or subspecialty. Saudi/American Board or Canadian/UK certification, or an equivalent qualification as outlined by the Medical Staff Credentialing Committee. A minimum of two (2) years of training in a specialty or subspecialty, plus post-training experience, is required. Professional Development The Assistant Consultant is expected to maintain and enhance professional knowledge and fulfill continuing education requirements. Participation in research projects is encouraged to advance knowledge, improve postgraduate education quality, and contribute to the national and international recognition of KFSH & RC. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and operates on a full-time basis within King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center. The position requires adherence to all hospital-related policies and procedures and active participation in departmental and hospital-wide administrative functions. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process. Qualified candidates are invited to apply.

40678cdc8bd3c42c.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Industries Company is seeking a Planning Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on demand operations and supply chain policy adherence, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. The specialist will be responsible for developing and refining demand forecasts, optimizing supply methods, and ensuring efficient inventory management. Key Responsibilities in Demand Operations Develop demand forecasts at multiple levels of aggregation for various time horizons. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate forecast results. Conduct cross-functional research activities to reconcile significant variances and refine the forecast model to reflect updated sales and marketing assumptions. Utilize a collaboration and consensus approach by working with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts. Assist in developing new or optimizing existing methods of supply, including emergency strategies, using corporate standard concepts. Perform quantitative and qualitative evaluations, considering the impact on logistics costs and structure. Investigate supply methods such as transportation, packaging, source of supply, and material flow for new or existing suppliers, as well as new supplier selection processes. Initiate, investigate, and develop medium to long-term planning strategies influencing supplier selection, and implement process improvements through innovation. Monitor warehouse inventory and communicate slow and non-moving inventory to relevant parties for immediate action. Prepare reports and statistics related to demand planning and forecasting. Use and maintain the Demand Planning Software as the primary forecasting system tool. Policy and Process Adherence Follow all relevant Supply Chain policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices, considering leading practices, business process enhancement, cost reduction, and productivity improvement. Promote the implementation and adherence to policies, processes, and operating procedures within Alkhorayef Industries Company (AIC). Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant planning or supply chain role. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage demand forecasts. Experience with demand planning software and statistical forecasting models. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within Alkhorayef Industries Company. The role involves cross-functional collaboration with various departments including Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

40ab99c399580d92.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع ابن سينا برو كير الطبي عن مدير جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يشارك شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بإدارة الجودة، ويشرف على أنشطة تخطيط الجودة لضمان الكفاءة والفعالية في العمليات اليومية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تحديد الأهداف والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية لضمان معايير الجودة العالية في الجهة ووحداتها التنظيمية. متابعة تنفيذ الخطط ووضع الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لتقييم مستوى تحقيق الأهداف. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية لتحسين جودة المخرجات والخدمات، ومتابعة تنفيذها. مراجعة وتطوير أنظمة ومعايير وإجراءات ضبط وتوكيد الجودة، ونشرها وتعميمها على الوحدات التنظيمية. متابعة أحدث المستجدات في أنظمة الجودة وتقديم المقترحات لتحديث الأنظمة المعتمدة. الإشراف على إعداد التقارير والملخصات المتعلقة بمعايير الجودة وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. المهارات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الجودة. القدرة على وضع وتطوير الخطط التشغيلية والمبادرات المتعلقة بالجودة. مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على الأنشطة وضمان توافر الموارد. القدرة على مراجعة وتطوير أنظمة ومعايير الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لمتابعة المستجدات وتقديم المقترحات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مجمع ابن سينا برو كير الطبي في جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب بيئة العمل التعاون مع فرق متعددة لضمان تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في جميع العمليات والخدمات. المؤهلات يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات اللازمة للمشاركة بفعالية في وضع وتنفيذ استراتيجيات الجودة، مع القدرة على الإشراف على العمليات وضمان الامتثال للمعايير المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

405e0944809d1f0b.description: About the Opportunity Stranger Soccer is expanding its global operations and is seeking an Operator & License Owner to establish, manage, and grow its football platform in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role offers an opportunity to build and operate a local football initiative, enhancing access to the sport within the city. The position is suited for individuals with an entrepreneurial drive and a passion for football. Role Overview As an Operator & License Owner, you will be responsible for leading the growth of Stranger Soccer in Jeddah. This involves developing local partnerships, overseeing operations, and cultivating an active community of players. You will have the autonomy to shape the local operation while leveraging the established systems, expertise, and support provided by Stranger Soccer's headquarters in Singapore. Key Responsibilities Launch and expand Stranger Soccer operations in Jeddah. Establish partnerships with football venues and secure suitable playing locations. Recruit, coordinate, and provide support to Official Hosts and local team members. Implement marketing strategies to attract players and expand the community. Manage game operations to ensure a positive player experience. Identify and pursue opportunities for enhancing and expanding local operations. Support and Resources The Singapore headquarters will provide comprehensive support, including: A technology platform for app functionality, payments, and operational management. Established operating systems and processes. Continuous guidance across operations, marketing, and growth strategies. Candidate Requirements Demonstrated passion for football and a comprehensive understanding of the local football community. An entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership. Experience in managing operations and achieving measurable results. Background in operations, community management, or customer experience. Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills. About Stranger Soccer Stranger Soccer simplifies access to football through its mobile application, enabling players to locate nearby games, reserve a spot, and participate. Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer operates in over 10 cities globally and has facilitated more than 100,000 games. The company seeks individuals committed to bringing this experience to local communities.

40da112bab17cc29.description: About Coastal Transportation Services Company Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides transportation services at the Red Sea destination. As part of the Red Sea Global Group, the company benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives, enhancing its ability to serve clients effectively. The company focuses on innovation and sustainable transportation solutions, including cutting-edge projects such as autonomous vehicles. Role Overview The Manager - Fleet Maintenance is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and operational readiness of the bus fleet under contract in Riyadh. This full-time role ensures that all relevant fleet vehicles are maintained in optimal condition, with scheduled servicing and preventive maintenance (PM) completed on time. The incumbent will audit and manage contractor performance to ensure fleet availability, reliability, and compliance with company standards. Key Responsibilities Oversee and manage maintenance contracts with service providers, ensuring all terms and conditions are met and addressing performance issues. Ensure maximum fleet availability by monitoring service schedules, downtime, and repairs, working proactively to minimize disruptions. Conduct regular audits of contractor maintenance activities to ensure adherence to industry standards, safety regulations, and contractual obligations. Ensure all relevant fleet vehicles undergo regular servicing, preventive maintenance (PM), and necessary repairs according to manufacturer guidelines and company policies. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to fleet maintenance, including uptime, service completion rates, and contractor efficiency. Monitor maintenance costs and optimize expenses through efficient resource allocation and identification of cost-saving opportunities. Liaise with operations, procurement, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution of maintenance activities and budget adherence. Ensure all buses comply with safety regulations, environmental guidelines, and operational standards set by Red Sea Global. Prepare and present periodic reports on fleet maintenance status, contractor performance, and critical issues. Identify opportunities for improving maintenance efficiency, reducing downtime, and enhancing overall fleet reliability. Follow all relevant functional policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies and procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of department systems, processes, and practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in fleet maintenance management. Demonstrated experience in contract management and auditing service provider performance. Proficiency in monitoring KPIs and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of safety regulations and environmental guidelines in fleet operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role operates within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, requiring collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders to achieve operational excellence in transportation services.

402cd0d8704d8d16.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور سائقًا ملتزمًا ومسؤولًا لضمان النقل الآمن والفعال، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة بمسؤولية وضمان الالتزام بمواعيد النقل المحددة. التبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير اضطراري قد يحدث أثناء القيادة. الالتزام التام بجميع قواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة على الطرق. التنبه الشديد لتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية أو مرورية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة على السيارة للتأكد من جاهزيتها وسلامتها. معالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على السيارة أثناء الاستخدام. رفع طلبات الصيانة المتخصصة عند ملاحظة أي خلل يتطلب فحص الخبراء. الالتزام الصارم بالأدلة الإجرائية، أدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية كسائق سيارة خاص تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للسيارة والتعامل مع المشكلات البسيطة. بيئة العمل يعمل السائق ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمواعيد والمسؤوليات المحددة لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: عسير المدينة: أبها الراتب: غير معلن

4091f4c3d15286f3.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Foreman Structural Fitter to join their team in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing all flat block assembly work and related activities, ensuring they are executed safely, effectively, and efficiently. The role holder will ensure adherence to applicable technical specifications, company policies, procedures, and work instructions, while also focusing on continuous improvement in flat block assembly productivity. Key Responsibilities Ensure all assigned works are executed safely and on schedule. Verify that all technical drawings and documentation are strictly followed. Determine the appropriate equipment or method based on project requirements. Secure valid work permits (Hot/Cold/Isolation, etc.) before initiating any activity. Attend safety and daily toolbox meetings, understanding the risks involved with each job. Perform tasks according to specific codes and follow engineering drawings. Monitor material usage to identify potential shortages and address them promptly. Examine finished work to ensure it meets IMI quality standards. The role requires a strong understanding of structural fitting processes and the ability to manage flat block assembly in accordance with documented plans and project requirements. The successful candidate will work within a dynamic environment focused on maritime industries, where safety and efficiency are paramount. 40a9ecbf178403e4.description: About Tronox Tronox is a global leader in the manufacturing of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that enhance the brightness and durability of everyday products. With a workforce of 5,700 individuals across six continents, Tronox is guided by strong values. The company is dedicated to responsibly transforming earth's resources into products and opportunities, with a vision to foster a sustainable world through refined minerals. Role Summary The Shift Operator L is responsible for ensuring Safe Quality Low Cost Sustainable Tons (SQLCST) at their assigned post or workstation. This full-time position, located in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, involves performing a variety of activities across multiple areas using complex equipment. The role requires continuous monitoring of operations to maintain product quality and inventory, along with providing coaching and guidance to develop technical expertise within the company. This role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor and adjust process parameters to maintain safe and optimal conditions, ensuring smooth and stable operations. Prepare equipment for maintenance procedures. Accurately and promptly enter data into the shift logsheet, logbook, and Control Room system (*, SIC). Perform thorough and timely plant rounds to identify issues with plant/equipment and ensure safe, stable operations. Raise maintenance job requests in the system as applicable. Detect and report process deviations promptly, utilizing A3 investigation for process problems. Participate in incident investigations. Utilize IT systems for reporting and data gathering. Strictly follow and perform all normal and emergency start-up and shutdown tasks according to approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure safe, stable, and error-free operations. Ensure all shift handover requirements are well-detailed, easy to understand, and maintain continuity of plant/process performance. Operate plant/equipment without guidance (*, field, localized DCS). Collect and deliver in-process samples for laboratory analysis. Participate in and assist team members with various tasks. Required Qualifications and Skills Basic knowledge of plant operations, manufacturing processes, technical safety, and standard operating procedures. Strong commitment to Health, Safety, Environment, and Sustainability (SHE). Good communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and planning skills. Ability to work effectively in a shift-based operational environment. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a shift-based operational environment. The role requires active participation in a team setting and adherence to strict safety and operational protocols.

40c4e3f132850fac.description: The successful candidate will support the design, installation, and maintenance of HVAC, fire protection, and plumbing systems, ensuring compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and project requirements. Key Responsibilities: Assist in reviewing mechanical drawings, designs, and technical specifications. Support the coordination and follow-up of HVAC, fire protection, and plumbing systems. Help ensure equipment efficiency and compliance with applicable standards. Coordinate with relevant teams to support project requirements and resolve technical issues. Participate in occasional site visits when required. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. Fresh graduate with no previous work experience required. Must not be currently employed. Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Willingness to learn and develop technical skills. Work Environment: The position is primarily office-based, with occasional field visits as required. If you are a recent graduate seeking to start your engineering career, we encourage you to apply.

40d02446fa91e613.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join their team in Al Khafji. This full-time role involves planning and supervising all electrical maintenance activities for plant equipment, including preventive and corrective maintenance, as well as monthly, annual, and overhauling work. The successful candidate will work under the direction of the Section Head to ensure operational efficiency and compliance with maintenance standards. Key Responsibilities Assign preventive and corrective maintenance jobs as directed by the Section Head, supervising and coordinating maintenance staff activities. Maintain accurate records, prepare reports, and compose correspondence related to work tasks. Execute work orders through the CMMS (SAP) and coordinate with the planning engineer for job completion and technical matters. Ensure necessary communications and relations are maintained to report on the status of actions and facilitate corrective measures. Assist the Maintenance Manager in executing corrective and planned maintenance in line with the annual scheduled maintenance plan. Perform technical evaluations of quotations from the purchase department and recommend appropriate choices. Prepare purchase requisitions for spare parts and consumables, ensuring budgetary constraints are met and strategic spares are available. Review and recommend new maintenance procedures and work instructions. Supervise, direct, and coordinate the activities of all personnel assigned to the area. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are carried out, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report on IMS objectives, targets, and programs, providing necessary resources for effective implementation. Ensure legal, contractual, and organizational compliance within the scope of activities. Identify root causes for non-conformances/deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary training actions. Conduct annual performance evaluations for reporting employees. Provide on-the-job training to new employees and evaluate their performance. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area. Monitor identified aspects and ensure operational controls are followed. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Ensure effective resource utilization and perform other assigned duties. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within a plant maintenance environment. Work Environment The role involves working near moving mechanical parts and in various outside weather conditions. Transform the field-to-lab validation cycle by connecting sensing, drilling, and sampling with high-throughput analytical methods and digital sample traceability. Design scalable field-lab-digital workflows that integrate field acquisition, laboratory analysis, and AI-enabled interpretation. Evaluate frontier technologies for practical exploration value, considering scientific robustness, readiness, deployment constraints, cost, risk, and scalability. Accelerate the transfer of proven cross-industry innovation into mineral exploration, particularly in autonomous systems, subsurface analytics, and remote sensing. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in technology application within exploration or related fields. Demonstrated ability to translate emerging technologies into practical, deployable solutions. Experience with advanced analytics, AI, and data integration in subsurface science. Background in adapting technologies and practices from sectors such as Oil & Gas, space exploration, OEMs, academia, and research institutions. Measures of Success Achieving shorter field-to-validated-result cycle times, enabling faster decision-making. Reducing laboratory turnaround time and avoidable re-analysis, with improved quality and reproducibility of results. Increasing confidence in drill-ready targets through integrated data and scientifically defensible validation. Faster progression from exploration concept to drill-ready target via effective application of automation, AI, and advanced sensing. Demonstrating improved exploration efficiency through reduced costs, re-sampling, re-testing, and decision latency. Successful adoption and scaling of high-value technologies, including AI-enabled exploration and cross-industry innovations. 40ea56b1c9b394fc.description: About the Role State Street is seeking a Senior Associate for Core Operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Manage the lifecycle of settlement instructions (including amendments/cancellations/partial settlement where permitted) in line with Edaa procedures and local cut-offs. Solid understanding of the KSA post-trade ecosystem, including Saudi Exchange, Muqassa (CCP), Edaa, and SAMA. 4006bacdec73c9ed.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Senior Manager Procurement for Botanica, its subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. Botanica focuses on integrating new species with local flora, managing over 1 million square meters, and has cultivated over 5 million plants since 2020, with a goal of 30 million by 2030. This full-time role is based in Tabuk, with operations in Umluj and Tabuk. Role Purpose The Senior Manager Procurement will lead procurement and supplier management for all Botanica business units. This includes plants and trees (local and imported), growing inputs (fertilizers, crop protection, substrates, pots), irrigation materials, equipment, fleet, spares, and services. The role ensures quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery, adhering to Botanica and Red Sea Global Group procurement policies, while maintaining ethical supplier relations. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the annual procurement plan based on approved budgets for Production, Nursery Operations, Landscape Maintenance, and support functions. Formulate category strategies for plants and trees, agricultural inputs, irrigation, equipment and fleet, and services. Aggregate demand and establish framework and rate agreements for recurring items. Manage the complete sourcing and purchasing cycle, including requisitions, RFQs or tenders, technical and commercial evaluations, negotiations, and purchase order issuance. Source imported plants from qualified international suppliers and manage pre-qualification, site visits, inspection, tagging, lead times, freight, and customs clearance. Maintain the approved vendor list, qualify new suppliers, evaluate performance, and manage contracts, claims, and disputes. Monitor savings, price benchmarks, and spend by category and business unit, ensuring compliance with procurement policy, ethics, and anti-bribery controls (ISO 37301). Collaborate with stores and Nursery Operations to agree on reorder levels for consumables and prevent stock-outs. Lead the procurement team, setting objectives, KPIs, and development plans. Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and Red Sea Global Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, and standard operating procedures. Champion safety, quality, and environmental management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301).
